# R4.14 — BL-38 package: ADR-0215 (15 program-level OQs) + the 24 READINESS_REPORT §10 minors — final proposed dispositions

Spec: `docs/tickets/163_R4.14__bl38-adr-0215-package.md` · base `svitali/harnessharness-r4.13a` @ 4ddc130 · offline-only · budget 800 changed lines.

## Summary

Briefs the program-level package: ADR-0215's 15 program-level deferred OQs — OQ-440's
promotion test evaluated against landed campaign evidence, OQ-425/OQ-292's HIR/2
`DecisionPoint` backlog named individually, and every defer-until-data candidate's entry
test re-read verbatim against landed state (recording whether the data NOW exists) —
plus the 24 open contract-level minors from `spec/READINESS_REPORT.md` §10 so "no
remaining deferred work" covers the spec-level residue too. Every in-scope id gets
exactly one FINAL proposed disposition from the closed token set; the ticket rules
nothing — all 39 rows are proposals for GATE-G7.

## Design decisions / verdicts

- **OQ-440 verdict:** the readiness report fixed the test (§7, quoted verbatim) —
  `EvolutionAcceptanceReport` under S4 `matched_total` + sign-stable `artifact_benefit`
  across ≥2 task families / ≥1 held-out level / ≥2 model families with `robust` bounds
  + `VariantRecord.maturity` recorded by the registry owner via amending ADR. **No
  landed campaign evidence satisfies it — zero promotions** (the recorded-model corpus
  is one generation; `ahe` alone stays `instrument-grade`, research families forced
  `research-grade`).
- **Defer-until-data:** the data does not exist for any of the twelve interim-adopted
  OQs (entry tests FAIL verbatim vs landed state); every entry test stays preserved
  verbatim as the re-entry trigger.
- **OQ-449** resolves on the landed V10 rule: `provider_sampling` joins
  `coupled_sources[]` only declared+measured (`coupling_agreement = true`);
  M5/judged stay `exploratory` — superseding the interim's literal never-joins.
- **OQ-459** resolves on the landed stricter cut: oracle classes only;
  `{critic_verdict, reward_model_output, participant_reported}` refuse outright.
- **Conform row:** `R4.15b` (164e skeleton explicitly scopes BL-37/BL-38 + the §10
  minors). The BL-37 briefs' `R4.15a` labels are naming drift flagged for the GATE-G7
  fleshing — never rewritten here. No `needs-code-leg(R4.15c)` item exists — all eight
  legs are records/spec-text work at R4.15b.
- **Anchor drift:** the ticket's Load pointer to
  `docs/build/OPERATIONAL_READINESS.md` for OQ-440's paragraph is stale — it lives at
  `spec/READINESS_REPORT.md:218`. Noted in the run ledger.
